signalValue.note: Listed on FutureCast early target board

vaultScouting.evaluation: Evans is a lean 6-2 / 205 LB. On the sophomore sit he shoots the A-gap for a TFL, picks the zone throw, and strips the quarterback on the blitz. Pad level into blocks is the next step.
vaultScouting.comparison: Evans comps to Cedric Gray — 6-2 / 220 rangy second-level LB who wins with burst, downhill trigger, and a knack for the ball.
vaultScouting.projection: Evans projects as a Year 1 special-teams LB, then a Year 2 package WILL, with Year 3 starter upside if he adds 15 pounds and keeps the trigger clean.
strengths: Evans shoots the A-gap off the snap and drops the back in the backfield before the line can get a hat on him.
Evans drops, reads the quarterback's eyes, and steps in front of the throw for the interception.
Evans times the blitz, hits the quarterback, and rips the ball loose.
Evans closes from sideline to sideline and arrives with heavy contact.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Evans fits a downhill WILL / money LB who can blitz, fill, and still drop and play the ball.
